name: Kiss Me with Unspoken Love
original_name: จูบฉันด้วยความรักไม่ต้องพูดออกมา
overview: Alone in a bar, college student Bert meets Ken, and the two have a one-night stand. Later, Bert discovers that Ken was his teacher of a class that he failed. Not only that, Ken is even the fiancé of Bert's sister-in-law. They plunge into a forbidden love affair, and family conflicts exacerbate things.
